description:
Because:

- The admin panel server runs on Express 4 and should move to Express 5.
- Express 5 passes app.listen errors to the callback instead of crashing.

This commit:

- Updates express to ^5.2.1 and @types/express to ^5.0.6.
- Gives the heartbeat and version handlers void block bodies.
- Rethrows the app.listen callback error so a failed bind still crashes.
- Adds a test for the rethrown listen error.

Closes FXA-14786
